_comment: Hand-kept list of game systems that the id counts cannot see. status: absent | unknown | present | verified (absent and unknown score 0, present 0.5, verified 1). A system marked verified must list verify_tests: automation tests that hold it to a vanilla run; the audit counts it as present unless every one of them passed in a test log matched to the audited commit. Seeded 2026-11-11 from PLAN.md and the test names; update a status when its evidence changes, and say what the evidence is.

systems.label: Block rendering (models, textures, tints, AO)
systems.evidence: PLAN.md M2: real block models and textures, smooth lighting, AO; tests McAssets.ModelBaker, McRender.BlockMesher; side-by-side shots, no automated vanilla pixel check

systems.label: Light engine (sky and block light)
systems.evidence: PLAN.md M2; tests McWorld.LightEngine, McCore.BlockLight; no vanilla light-level comparison test
